voice.title: Hear how DoctorNearMe
voice.intro: Before the first visit, the family talks to the DoctorNearMe intake assistant, built on ElevenLabs, in their own language. The therapist walks into session 1 already knowing the history, so the session goes to the child.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.intro: Something else on your mind? Ask us on the demo call.
faq.a1: Early intervention therapists and child psychologists use it every day. Centres subscribe for their team. Parents and specialists never need an account: they get a link from the therapist.
faq.a2: Always the clinician. DoctorNearMe is not a diagnosis. It documents what was said and suggests ratings with evidence. The clinician reviews, edits and decides every item.
faq.q3: What happens in the AI intake call?
faq.a3: Before session 1 the parent opens a private link and talks to the DoctorNearMe assistant in Telugu, Hindi or English. It asks for consent first, then one question at a time. The therapist receives the recording and a pre-session brief with the parent's own words.
faq.a4: The ISAA (Indian Scale for Assessment of Autism), all 40 items, with an evidence quote and timestamp for each suggestion.
faq.a5: English, Hindi and Telugu. Reports are written in English.
faq.a6: Book a demo. We walk you through DoctorNearMe on a sample case, then set up your centre's workspace and send your team their logins.

notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.intro: DoctorNearMe helps families and child development professionals work together. This notice explains what we collect, why, who processes it, how long we keep it and the rights you have under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
notice.controller: DoctorNearMe (pilot operator) decides how this data is used (data fiduciary). Each clinic or therapist you work with is responsible for the clinical records they create.

collect.account: Your account: name, email address, mobile number and sign-in details.
collect.children: Your children: name, date of birth, sex (optional) and your relationship to them.
collect.consent: Your permissions (consents): what you allowed or withdrew, when, and the version of the text you saw.
collect.health: Health profile: blood group, allergies, medicines, conditions, birth and development history, emergency contact.
collect.documents: Documents you or the care team upload (reports, prescriptions, school letters).
collect.intake: AI intake voice call (only with your permission): the call audio and its transcript, and the summary prepared for the therapist.
collect.sessions: Session recordings (only with your permission): audio recorded at the centre, transcripts, observations suggested by AI and confirmed by the therapist, reports and referrals.
collect.assessments: Questionnaires your care team sends you (for example the developmental check-in): your answers and the summary the team publishes.
collect.plans: Therapy plans (IEP): goals, progress the care team records, and the plan versions published to you.
collect.notifications: Notifications we send you in the app, by email or WhatsApp.
collect.website: If you ask for a demo on our website: name, email, role and centre.
collect.appointments: Appointments you book: provider, service, time, place, status and changes. The provider sees your child's name and age.
collect.scribe: AI session notes (only with your permission): notes, goal progress and prescription drafts prepared by AI from recordings made at the clinic. The clinician checks every suggestion; you see a note only when the clinician shares it with you.
collect.homeProgram: Home activities: the activities your care team publishes for practice at home, and what you log (done, how it went, minutes, notes).
collect.messages: Messages with the care team: what you and the care team write in DoctorNearMe conversations, attached document links, and when you last read them.
collect.videoCalls: Video appointments: the Google Meet link. You join signed in to your own Google account; your email is never added to the provider's calendar.
collect.screen: Developmental check-in from our public check-in page: your child's age band and your answers, without any name. If you use voice, the call is processed by ElevenLabs.
collect.payments: Payments you make on DoctorNearMe: appointments, session packages and session charges (amount, status, refunds, receipt numbers and Razorpay reference numbers), and your child's account with each centre. Razorpay handles your card or UPI details; we never see or store them.
collect.ratings: Ratings you give after a completed visit: stars and an optional comment. They are shown without your name; only DoctorNearMe admins can see who wrote them.
collect.followUp: Questions to the AI follow-up assistant (only with your permission): your questions about your child's shared plans and the answers, kept for 90 days. If you ask by voice, the call is processed by ElevenLabs.
collect.voiceUsage: Voice usage: when you use voice (check-in, booking, follow-up questions), we record that your account had a voice call, with which assistant and for how long. Nothing about your child, no recording and no transcript. We use it to keep voice free and fair.

notice.purposes: To run your family account and your child's care with the professionals you choose; to prepare intake summaries, transcripts and draft reports that a professional checks; to send you reminders and updates; to keep records the law requires; and to keep the service secure. We never sell data and never use it for advertising.
